description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called SettingsRootView, which manages the settings interface of a macOS application. It includes multiple tabs such as General, Channels, Skills, Sessions, Cron, Config, Instances, Voice Wake, Permissions, Debug, and About, and handles user interactions, permission monitoring, and UI updates.

classes.name: SettingsRootView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI View struct that displays and manages application settings with multiple tabs.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: Enumeration of all settings tabs along with their properties such as title and icon.

classes.name: SettingsTabRouter
classes.description: Static singleton enum to handle pending tab switching requests, ensuring decoupled navigation control.

methods.name: validTab(for:)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate tab to display based on permissions and enabled state.

methods.name: refreshSnapshotPaths
methods.description: Asynchronously updates snapshot path data from the Gateway connection.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring(for:)
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the selected tab.

methods.name: stopPermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Disables permission monitoring when the view disappears.
